subject: Request: VP/CIO attendance — quiet window adjustment for BrightForge executive demo
thread_body:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@brightforge.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightforge.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: VP/CIO attendance for Dec 22 executive demo

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick responses last week. We’re trying to lock the 45-minute executive demo for BrightForge on Dec 22 at 10:00am PT. Our CTO, Rajiv, and VP Product (Tom) both said they'd like to attend.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood hold a quiet window so our CTO has a minimal-interruption slot to join live?
- If either of ours can’t make it, can you confirm who from your side will be the executive sponsor (VP-level) to speak to architecture and ROI?

I attached our internal agenda; the key focus will be query latency at high concurrency and data residency questions.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can finalize invites.

Best,
Ellen
BrightForge

Attachment: BrightForge_Demo_Agenda_v1.docx (attachment stub)

---
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <ellen@brightforge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: VP/CIO attendance for Dec 22 executive demo

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and the agenda. We can absolutely hold a quiet window and make sure the meeting is set up for an exec-level conversation. A few quick notes:

- Our VP of Product, Marissa Cole, will be the exec sponsor if Rajiv needs an equivalent-level counterpart. Marissa will cover platform economics and customer ROI.
- I’ll coordinate with Neha (CS lead) to tighten the demo to the 45-minute executive flow and keep deep-dive follow-ups separate.
- Can you confirm whether Rajiv prefers a live Q&A or a dedicated 15-minute technical deep-dive right after the exec demo?

I’ve attached an updated Redwood agenda (lightweight). Will follow up with calendar holds.

Thanks,
Mina
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf (attachment stub)

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen@brightforge.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 11:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: VP/CIO attendance for Dec 22 executive demo

Ellen — I’m happy to take the sponsor seat for the Dec 22 session.

Proposed plan:
1) 10:00–10:15am PT — Executive overview (me) covering business outcomes and cost/latency guarantees.
2) 10:15–10:35am PT — Live demo focused on your concurrency/latency patterns (Neha to drive).
3) 10:35–10:45am PT — Rapid Q&A; if Rajiv wants deeper kernel/infrastructure detail we’ll book a follow-up 30-min technical deep-dive next week.

If Tom or Rajiv need a different timeframe (e.g., earlier same day), tell me and we’ll move. Otherwise, I’ll accept the invite once you finalize.

—Marissa
VP Product, Redwood Inference

---
From: Ellen Park <ellen@brightforge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@brightforge.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: VP/CIO attendance for Dec 22 executive demo

Marissa — perfect, that run of show looks great.

Quick update: Rajiv just flagged an international travel conflict and may land back in the US on Dec 23 instead. He’s asking whether we can shift the exec demo earlier on Dec 21 at 11:00am PT or keep Dec 22 but record the session and do a separate tech deep-dive with Rajiv when he’s back.

We prefer not to lose the live exec touchpoint — is Dec 21 at 11:00am PT possible on your side? If not, we’ll keep Dec 22 and plan the recorded fallback plus a 30-min technical follow-up with Rajiv on Dec 27.

Thanks,
Ellen

Attachment: BrightForge_MATP_checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)

---
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <ellen@brightforge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: VP/CIO attendance for Dec 22 executive demo

Ellen — Dec 21 at 11:00am PT works for our execs. I checked with Marissa and Neha; we’ll swap internal calendars so Marissa will lead the 11:00 slot and Neha will run the demo flow.

Action items I’m capturing:
- Marissa: executive overview + ROI talk, calendar invite accepted.
- Neha: tighten demo to 20 minutes and prep the concurrency scenario; bring token-level latency plot.
- Mina: send final invite to BrightForge with the quiet-window note and add HubSpot record link.
- Ellen: confirm attendee names and whether Rajiv wants the session recorded if he eventually re-joins on Dec 23.

I’ll attach the final agenda and send the calendar hold in the next hour. Looking forward to it.

Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
